name: lua51
description: Lua 5.1, the Lua 5.1.5 release, built as C. Each feature is a departure from the stock build, made only when requested.

bitop.description: Builds Lua BitOp 1.0.2's bit library into the library and opens it in luaL_openlibs, as LuaJIT opens its own bit

cpp.description: Compiles Lua as C++, so a Lua error raises a C++ exception rather than calling longjmp. Unlike the other features it takes something away: the API then has C++ linkage for every consumer of the installed lua51, which must include lua.h without an extern "C" around it, and C code cannot link it

int64.description: Makes lua_Integer long long on every target, in place of ptrdiff_t, which is 32 bits on a 32-bit target

luajit-api.description: Adds the C API calls past Lua 5.1 that LuaJIT 2.1 provides, under its names and signatures, and files package.preload in the registry under _PRELOAD, as LuaJIT does
